legal.description: CCPA imposed Rs 2 lakh penalty on Axelia Solutions (PharmEasy operator) for 'basket sneaking' dark pattern; auto-added Rs 99 three-month subscription without explicit consent affecting ~24,000 consumers. Directed to remove feature, issue refunds, revise T&Cs.

legal.entity: South Chemists and Distributors Association (SCDA) / DCGI
legal.description: SCDA urged Central government and DCGI to take action against PharmEasy for alleged violation of Drug Rules; accused of providing doctor consultation without following prescription regulations for scheduled medicines.

legal.entity: All India Organization of Chemists and Druggists (AIOCD) / DCGI
legal.description: AIOCD apprised DCGI about Swiggy-PharmEasy rapid drug delivery partnership, urging immediate action; cited concerns about expired/counterfeit drugs, prescription checking, and AMR.
Delhi High Court asked Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to frame a policy for online sale of drugs within four months, warning it would be the last opportunity.
legal.notes: Part of ongoing legal battle; SCDA filed writ petition alleging e-pharmacies are illegal

legal.description: API Holdings filed DRHP with SEBI for Rs 6,250 crore IPO; SCDA urged SEBI to reject DRHP citing illegality of e-pharmacy business under Indian law.
legal.notes: IPO was later withdrawn due to unfavorable market conditions
